summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting and class A meeting scheduled for July 13, 2026, along with proxy cards and a class B written resolution. The filing is a routine procedural document for shareholder meetings to consider unspecified proposals, including an amended memorandum and articles. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or special situation event is described. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of meeting materials, not triggering any special-situations classification.
